heading: Written paper (copy check)
intro: Students download the question paper, solve it on paper and upload their copy before the end time. Fill this in and the test is created, assigned and published.

fields.name: Assessment title
fields.liveHint: Students can open the test and upload their copy only inside this window. Leave “Live from” blank to open it right away, and “Live till” blank to keep it open with no end date.
fields.durationHint: Time a student gets to upload the copy after clicking Start Assessment — not the time to write it. Leave blank for {{minutes}} minutes.
fields.totalMarksHint: With AI checking, the marks are read from the paper; this is used to cross-check them.
fields.batchHint: Students of these batches get the test.
fields.instructionsPlaceholder: Anything students should know. The question paper is added below automatically.

slot.answerKeyHint: Only for checking — students never see it. Skip it if the paper already prints the answers.
slot.keyHasScheme: This PDF also has the marking scheme
slot.markingSchemeHint: Step-wise marks per question. Only for checking — students never see it.
slot.choose: Drop a PDF here or click to choose

ai.title: AI checks
ai.description: The paper is read into questions with marks (using the answer key and marking scheme if given). You review them once, then every copy is checked question by question.

teacher.title: Teacher checks
teacher.description: Copies are checked by hand. No credits are used.
teacher.later: You can turn on AI checking later from the test's Submissions tab.

ai.estimateFailed: Could not read the uploaded files.
ai.privateNote: The answer key and marking scheme are used only to check copies; they are not shown to students.
ai.uploadPaperFirst: Upload the question paper to see what reading it costs.
ai.cannotRead: {{reason}} Upload a readable PDF, or choose “Teacher checks”.
ai.estimateLine_one: ≈{{credits}} credits to read the files ({{count}} page)
ai.estimateLine_other: ≈{{credits}} credits to read the files ({{count}} pages)
ai.insufficient: Not enough credits to read these files. Top up, or choose “Teacher checks”.
ai.howItWorks: Charged once, when the questions come back. You review them on the Submissions tab; each uploaded copy is then charged per page.

toasts.createFailed: Could not create the assessment. Please try again.
toasts.createdReading: Assessment created and published. Reading the paper in the background (≈{{credits}} credits) — you will get an alert when the questions are ready to review.
toasts.createdReadNotStarted: Assessment created and published, but the paper could not be read. Try again from the Submissions tab, or check the copies by hand.

errors.endAfterStart: The end must be after the start
errors.endInFuture: The end must be in the future
errors.notPdf: Only PDF files can be used here.
errors.tooBig: The file is larger than {{mb}} MB.
